newsitem.title: JORDAN: Hamas urges "continuous intifada" against settlement.
newsitem.headline: Hamas urges "continuous intifada" against settlement.

text.p: The Islamic Resistance Movement Hamas called on Tuesday for a Palestinian uprising to protest the start of work at a planned Israeli settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
"The Palestinian Authority should answer the call of the Palestinian people to go into continuous intifada (uprising)," Hamas spokesman Ibrahim Ghoshe told Reuters.

Ghoshe criticised Palestinian Authority President Yasser Arafat "for using only peaceful means" to protest the groundbreaking at Jabal Abu Ghneim, known as Har Homa in Israel, and for not cutting contact between Israel and Palestinians.
"The road of resistance is the only road which can affect the Israelis," Ghoshe said. "Peaceful pressure...will not get anything from the Israelis."

He said the new "intifada" should not be limited to a few days like fighting in September after Israel's opening of a Jerusalem tunnel by Moslem holy sites in which 61 Palestinians and 15 Israelis were killed.

"The Palestinian people will not accept to participate in a small intifada like that of the tunnel...and afterwards the building at Abu Ghneim will continue just like it did with the tunnel," Ghoshe said in English. "The young people are eager to start the intifada and not stop until the occupation is ended."
